title: docs + scaffold: `plugin-spec.mdx` stops promising the non-existent `@objectstack/testing` and points at `@objectstack/verify`; the `create-objectstack` blank template ships a test story (epic hotcrm#1579, step 5b)
body:
Blocked-by: #15951

Sub-issue of the epic **hotcrm#1579** (step 5b). Filed by the director seat (objectstack#12708, summon #15); `pm:epic` reserves it for the epic PM — ⛔ not `pm:queue`. `domain:*` / type / priority are triage's. Ruling provenance and the design (B′) are on #15951 — read that card first.

**Governing text.** Protocol baseline (maintainer 2026-09-05, verbatim): 「本项目以协议为基准。所以开发应该对其协议，协议有问题应该立卡修改协议」 — the published docs are part of what an app author (and every AI reading them) treats as the contract; a documented package that does not exist is a contract the platform is not honouring.

## Measured (`origin/main` `04679418`)

- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/plugin-spec.mdx:758-765` — a `<Callout type="warn">` says the `@objectstack/testing` package with `createTestContext()` / `createTestEnvironment()` is **"proposed — there is no such published package today"**, then shows snippets importing it. Every app author who follows the docs is told to test against a package that does not exist, and hotcrm's hand-built `makeCtx()` is exactly the shape that snippet teaches.
- `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/package.json` — scripts: `dev`, `start`, `build`, `validate`, `typecheck`. **No `test` script, no vitest, no `test/` directory.** A scaffolded app starts with no way to assert its own business behaviour, so the first test its author writes is a hand-rolled kernel assembly (as `examples/app-crm`, `app-todo`, `app-showcase` each did).

## The ask

1. **Docs.** Rewrite the "Plugin Testing" section of `plugin-spec.mdx` around what ships: `bootStack` + the in-process handle from #15951. Delete the ghost callout and every `@objectstack/testing` import. Where the platform's own docs generator owns the text (`check:generated`), fix the source and regenerate — never hand-edit a generated page. Search the whole `content/docs` tree for other `@objectstack/testing` / `createTestContext` mentions and treat them the same way (`git grep -n "objectstack/testing\|createTestContext\|createTestEnvironment" -- content/ skills/ packages/*/README.md`); published `skills/**` text that teaches testing follows through the generator.
2. **Scaffold.** The blank template gets: `"test": "vitest run"`, a `vitest.config.ts`, `@objectstack/verify` + `vitest` as devDependencies at the template's pinned range, and **one** example test that boots the template's own stack with `bootStack` and asserts one business fact through the handle. Keep it to one file — this is a starting point, not a framework.
3. `create-objectstack`'s own tests assert the scaffolded project's `pnpm test` runs green (the scaffold test that already exercises `validate`/`typecheck` extends by one step).

## Acceptance

- `git grep -n "objectstack/testing"` over `content/`, `skills/`, `packages/` returns zero hits outside a changelog.
- A freshly scaffolded blank app runs `pnpm test` green with the one example test.
- Changeset: `create-objectstack` **minor** (new template files); docs-only changes need none. `Clause-②: no` (no exported symbol changes) — the dispatching seat re-reads from content.

## Not in this card

The handle itself (#15951); derived proof families (step 5c); hotcrm's migration (hotcrm card); any change to `os test`.

Refs: hotcrm#1579 · #15951 · ADR-0054.
